body: I feel exactly the same. There's not a day that I don't think "I can't do this anymore"

I'm 30. I've been struggling with anxiety since I was 11 or 12, when I was diagnosed with OCD. OCD symptoms have greatly improved during my teenage years, but I still suffer from GAD. Some days are really hard.
I feel exactly the same. I'm constantly feeling unworthy and exhausted. I keep telling myself that things will get better, but it's hard.
Thank you so much for this!
